scope.description: PersistentStorage direct Storage API use on a live backend with a deterministic returned entry-serialization error after earlier operations were prepared.
assumptions: Entry implements the required Entry, Serialize and Deserialize interfaces; serialization error is returned normally, not panic.
Successful database initialization and I/O outside the selected error; no concurrent writers or compaction.
excluded: No claim of a legal whole-cluster history continuing after a core storage panic.
No crash, power-loss durability, RocksDB write failure or application endpoint is tested.

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison
Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: Use the public Entry serialization extension point to supply a returned error; all other entry values serialize normally.
Direct backend calls isolate the explicit Storage interface contract; no claim that the whole Paxos core continues after its storage panic.
Observe get_log_len from the live object and promise/entry data from backend public readers, then reopen as a diagnostic.

plan_uncertainties: Compilation of the default omnipaxos target enables its existing persistent-storage dev dependency; preparation is not semantic evidence.
No cluster consequence, crash recovery failure, or RocksDB atomic-commit failure is inferred from a local backend contract violation.
Reopened state is retained as diagnostic corroboration of persistence after the later successful call, not a separate requirement.
